# Security policy

Report suspected vulnerabilities through a private GitHub Security Advisory:

`https://github.com/gbollyjay825/vessel_caller/security/advisories/new`

Do not open a public issue or include credentials, session cookies, MFA/recovery
codes, personal data, evidence URLs, payment identifiers, database exports, or
exploit details in public channels.

Include the affected environment/version, impact, sanitized reproduction,
timestamps/request IDs, and whether active exploitation or data exposure is
suspected. For an active incident, revoke exposed credentials and follow
`docs/runbooks/monitoring-incident.md`.

Security fixes receive supported-release backports based on impact. High or
critical findings block release and are triaged immediately. Moderate findings
require a named owner, compensating control, written approval, and expiry.
